content: In recent years there has been increasing interest on the issue of disinformation spreading on online social media. Global concern over false (or "fake") news as a threat to modern democracies has been frequently raised–ever since 2016 US Presidential elections–in correspondence of events of political relevance, where the proliferation of manipulated and low-credibility content attempts to drive and influence people opinions BIBREF0BIBREF1BIBREF2BIBREF3.
